Which of these best describes how fast the state will move through this section of space?

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: choices_flow.ors.1.sy
- 'The state moves slowly.':
    correct: false
- 'The state moves quickly.':
    correct: false
- 'No way to say.':
    correct: true
    feedback: 'Right! It is only by comparison that we can say one arrow is "fast" and another "slow".'
```
